J U D G M E N T
ANIL R. DAVE, J.
1.
Hearing of this appeal was adjourned to await the
decision of the Larger Bench in Commnr., Central Excise,
Madras v. M/s. Adison & Co. Ltd. (C.A. No.7906 of 2002).
2.
Now,   the   judgment   of   the   Larger   Bench   has   been
delivered on 29.08.2016.
3. 
In view of the said judgment, the impugned order is
set aside and the appeal is allowed with no orders as to
costs.
